faq_heading: Homes near Our Lady of Good Counsel: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near Our Lady of Good Counsel get a child a place?
faq.a: No. Our Lady of Good Counsel is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the Our Lady of Good Counsel home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Our Lady of Good Counsel whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Our Lady of Good Counsel sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 704 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,120,000, townhomes $570,000, condos $415,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Our Lady of Good Counsel?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Our Lady of Good Counsel the median was 30 days on the market, closing at 96.4% of the list price, with 7% of sales above the list price for the 704 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Our Lady of Good Counsel?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Forsyth Road Elementary (0.5 km north), Honour Secondary School (0.5 km west) and Mary Jane Shannon Elementary (1.0 km east).

Our Lady of Good Counsel is an independent school in Surrey, at 10504 139 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Our Lady of Good Counsel. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 2 km of the school.
How the Our Lady of Good Counsel search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Our Lady of Good Counsel, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Our Lady of Good Counsel sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 704 homes sold within 2 km of Our Lady of Good Counsel: 83 houses, 36 townhomes and 578 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $415,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Our Lady of Good Counsel

29 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Our Lady of Good Counsel in a straight line (19 elementary, 9 secondary, 1 other; 2 independent). The closest is Forsyth Road Elementary, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is Surrey Academy of Innovative Learning, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Honour Secondary School (0.5 km); the nearest independent school is Honour Secondary School (0.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Kwantlen Park Secondary (1.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: Forsyth Road Elementary (0.5 km north), Mary Jane Shannon Elementary (1.0 km east), Lena Shaw Elementary (1.1 km south-east), James Ardiel Elementary (1.5 km north), Surrey Traditional (1.6 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Forsyth Road Elementary, 0.5 km north of Our Lady of Good Counsel.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Our Lady of Good Counsel

items.t: Ask Our Lady of Good Counsel how admission works. A short distance does not give a child a place.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Our Lady of Good Counsel are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median condo within 2 km of Our Lady of Good Counsel was $415,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Forsyth Road Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.5 km north of Our Lady of Good Counsel. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
